_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-async-load.sh (s-rta-0929 asyncload, .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0929/plan-asyncload.md 5.9 + HARMONY ADOPTION AL1-AL12). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-async-load.py. Fixtures are generated per run into <out>/media (videos by ffmpeg, PNGs by PIL, APFS clones by cp -c): every path is new to the app instance.
_stallMaxMs: the longest message-thread wait of a heartbeat ping (peak_message_stall_ms, polled every 15 ms) during a staged load (plan R10: the no-open load cost 18-20 ms + one GL-frame fence drain <= 12 ms + the landings ~0.2 ms each; the mediaopen probe's bar)
_swapMaxS: a staged 16 x 4K load answers (the cut) within this many seconds of the post (plan R3: 16 x ~68 ms / 2 pool threads, x2 if both land on E cores)
_cancelAnswerMaxS: a superseded / cancelled load's REST answer comes within this of the superseding post (the cancel never waits for an open)
_holdMaxPerCut: the swap's fence holds the canvas for 1-2 frames (120 Hz display) -- probe-media-open's holdMaxPerDrop
_boxTol: dbox(X, Y): both arrays box-averaged in 16x16 blocks, then mean |diff| over RGB (0..255) -- probe-image-load's measure
_audioGapFactor: the audio callback's longest inter-arrival gap during a load <= factor x audio_callback_period_ms (a GUARD, plan R9: a load never runs on the RT callback). Raised only with the arithmetic in the report, never silently.
_uploadsMinPerS: the OLD composition's playing 1080p clip keeps uploading frames during the staged window (30 fps content: ~30/s; a frozen show 0)
_lateMaxPerLoad: video_late_frames delta over a load (the old clip's decode thread is not starved by the openers, adoption AL1)
